profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI/ML | MSCS @ Georgia Tech | CodePath Mentor
profile.summary: Software engineer with hands-on experience in full-stack development, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and AI/LLM integration. Experienced in building interactive web apps, optimizing UX/UI and system performance, and creating efficient data pipelines with analytics platforms for startups and small businesses. Master's in Computer Science graduate from Georgia Tech. Previously ran a Medium blog, simplifying AI/LLM concepts and fundamentals for the general (non-technical) audience.

positions.title: Founder / Software Engineer
positions.description: Helping startups and small businesses identify practical AI opportunities and turn them into full-stack tools, integrations, and automated workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Helped startups and small businesses validate ideas, define product direction, understand market positioning, and build prototypes, MVPs, full-stack applications, and data workflows.

positions.title: Founder / Software Engineer (S24)
positions.description:
• Built an AI-driven online learning platform that identifies user skill gaps and generates personalized roadmaps with interactive courses, projects and simulation exercises for upskilling.
• Selected for Georgia Tech’s competitive startup accelerator to build and launch, securing $5,000 in seed funding and $150,000 in business services.

certifications.name: Group 2 Social / Behavioral Research Investigators and Key Personnel
certifications.title: Group 2 Social / Behavioral Research Investigators and Key Personnel

volunteerExperiences.description:
Mentor first-time students, providing semester-long guidance that contributed to an increased retention rate in their first course.

Led monthly 1:1 check-ins, helping mentees improve study strategies, master platform tools, and access community resources resulting in 81% reporting feeling more connected to CodePath’s community.

Acted as a liaison between students and CodePath staff, contributing to 74% of mentees reporting they could navigate CodePath more effectively.
